There are a lot of thoughts I want to share about @Tesla and @TeslaSI after this recent earnings call.  

Ashok @aelluswamy  once again was the steady voice if you knew how to listen to what he said.  Phil Duan @pduan has said the same things to me recently at the Cybercab Launch

Ashok on earnings call..
Robotaxi scaling is software driven through the end of this year.  Will expand service until 2am soon, then 24/7 later this year.  High speed roads, and more weather conditions coming too.  Expected scaling expansion to transition a regulatory critical

Ashok @aelluswamy  on the earnings call.  FSD v15 later this year for @Robotaxi and consumer cars.  So no change on this timeline without any additional fidelity.  New Tesla maps with v15 sounded really promising for better data and navigation.
